title: HR Manager – US Operations
description:
Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced HR Manager to manage US HR operations from our Hyderabad office. The role covers core HR, US payroll through Rippling, employee benefits administration, finance coordination, and partial support for talent acquisition.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will be comfortable independently managing day\-to\-day operations, maintaining accurate employee and payroll records, and coordinating with US employees, leadership, finance teams, and external service providers.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Core HR Operations
   

  

* Manage the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, employee changes, documentation, and offboarding.
* Maintain accurate employee records, HR policies, and standard operating procedures.
* Handle employee queries related to payroll, benefits, leave, and company policies.
* Coordinate applicable US employment compliance requirements with internal stakeholders and external advisors.
* Prepare HR reports and maintain confidential employee information.


 US Payroll and Rippling
   

  

* Independently manage US payroll processing through Rippling, ensuring accuracy and timely completion.
* Validate payroll inputs, including salary changes, variable pay, deductions, leave adjustments, and final settlements.
* Manage employee information, payroll workflows, and reporting within Rippling.
* Resolve payroll discrepancies and coordinate with Rippling support and finance teams.
* Maintain payroll records and support reconciliations, audits, and year\-end activities.


 Benefits Administration
   

  

* Administer US employee benefits, including health insurance, retirement plans, and other company offerings.
* Coordinate benefit enrollments, qualifying life event changes, and employee exits.
* Support open enrollment and communicate benefit information clearly to employees.
* Work with benefits brokers and providers to resolve employee queries and reconcile benefit invoices.


 Finance Coordination
   

  

* Partner with finance on payroll funding, payroll reconciliation, benefits costs, and employee reimbursements.
* Review HR\-related invoices and coordinate approvals and payment tracking.
* Maintain supporting documentation for payroll expenses, reporting, and audits.
* Support headcount and employee cost reporting.


 Talent Acquisition Support
   

  

* Support recruitment for selected roles through sourcing, screening, and interview coordination.
* Work with hiring managers to understand requirements and track hiring progress.
* Coordinate offers, background verification, and onboarding handoffs.
* Maintain candidate records and provide a positive candidate experience.


**Required Qualifications And Experience**
* Prior experience independently managing US HR operations is mandatory.
* Hands\-on experience processing US payroll using Rippling is mandatory.
* Strong working knowledge of US payroll processes, employee benefits, and HR administration.
* Experience coordinating payroll and benefits reconciliations with finance teams.
* Familiarity with US federal and state employment requirements and the ability to coordinate specialist guidance when needed.
* Experience supporting recruitment and managing hiring coordination.
* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, attention to detail, and data accuracy.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage confidential information and work independently with US stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
* Willingness to work from the Hyderabad office during the 2:00 PM–10:00 PM IST shift.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience supporting employees across multiple US states.
* Experience managing benefits renewals, open enrollment, and payroll audits.
* Relevant HR or payroll certifications.

**Job Description**
 Your potential has a place here with TTEC's award\-winning employment experience. As a Principal Analyst working onsite in Hyderabad, India, you'll be a part of bringing humanity to business. \#experienceTTEC
   

  

 Our employees have spoken. Our purpose, team, and company culture are amazing and our Great Place to Work® certification in India says it all!
   

  

**Job Title**
**Principal Analyst – Taleo Application (IT Enterprise Solutions)**
**Job Summary**
 We are seeking an experienced Principal Analyst to own the strategy, configuration, integration, and support of the Oracle Taleo Enterprise Edition (ATS) platform. The ideal candidate will bring strong functional command of the end\-to\-end recruitment lifecycle, deep hands\-on expertise across all Taleo modules and features, and proven experience delivering full\-cycle Taleo ATS implementations. This role requires a seasoned professional who can independently manage integrations with HRMS/ERP systems, background check providers, job boards, and career sites, while serving as the primary point of contact for stakeholders and external vendors.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
***End\-to\-End Recruitment Process \& Taleo Application Ownership***
* Own and drive functional and technical ownership of the Oracle Taleo Enterprise Edition platform across all modules, including Taleo Recruiting (OTAC), Onboarding, Career Sections (internal and external), and Taleo Connect Client (TCC).
* Demonstrate strong functional knowledge of the complete recruitment lifecycle – requisition creation and approval, sourcing, candidate screening, interview scheduling, offer management, background verification, and onboarding – and translate this knowledge into effective Taleo configurations.
* Lead the design, configuration, testing, and rollout of new Taleo features, workflows, and enhancements aligned to evolving recruitment and business needs.
* Provide advanced production support and root\-cause troubleshooting for issues related to requisitions, workflows, offers, career sites, and integrations.
* Manage Taleo upgrades, patches, and release cycles, ensuring minimal disruption to live recruitment operations.


***Taleo Connect Client (TCC) \& Integrations***
* Serve as the hands\-on subject matter expert for Taleo Connect Client (TCC), independently building, testing, scheduling, and troubleshooting inbound/outbound data integrations and exports/imports.
* Design, build, and maintain integrations between Taleo and HRMS/ERP systems, including Oracle ERP/HCM, ensuring seamless data flow for candidate, requisition, and employee records.
* Own integrations with background check providers, job boards/aggregators, and career site platforms, ensuring accurate posting, sourcing, and candidate data exchange.
* Work with XML, CSV, flat\-file structures, web services, and APIs to support integration development, monitoring, and error resolution.
* Ensure data integrity, security, and compliance across all integration touchpoints in line with organizational and regulatory requirements.


***Implementation \& Project Delivery***
* Independently manage and execute Taleo ATS implementations end\-to\-end, from requirements gathering and solution design through configuration, testing, cutover, and hypercare support.
* Prepare functional and technical specification documents, configuration workbooks, test scripts, and cutover/rollout plans.
* Lead user acceptance testing (UAT) cycles, coordinate defect resolution, and manage go\-live readiness.
* Drive process improvement initiatives to optimize recruitment workflows, system performance, and user experience.


***Stakeholder \& Vendor Management***
* Act as the primary liaison between HR, Talent Acquisition, IT, and business leadership to gather requirements and translate them into scalable Taleo solutions.
* Build strong working relationships with stakeholders across geographies, managing expectations, timelines, and priorities effectively.
* Manage relationships with Oracle Taleo support, implementation partners, background check vendors, and job board/career site providers, including contract deliverables, SLAs, and issue escalation.
* Communicate clearly and confidently with technical and non\-technical audiences, through written documentation, presentations, and verbal updates to stakeholders and leadership.


***Reporting, Compliance \& Mentoring***
* Develop and maintain standard and custom Taleo reports and dashboards to support recruiting metrics, compliance reporting, and executive insights.
* Ensure recruitment processes and system configurations align with applicable compliance requirements (e.g., EEOC, OFCCP, GDPR, and internal audit/SOX controls where applicable).
* Provide technical and functional guidance to junior analysts and HR systems team members, and contribute to knowledge transfer, training, and documentation.


**Required Qualifications**
***Experience***
* 8–12\+ years of overall IT/HR systems experience, with a significant portion focused on Oracle Taleo Enterprise Edition.
* Proven track record of having managed and executed at least one full\-cycle Taleo ATS implementation, in addition to multiple enhancement and support engagements.
* Mandatory hands\-on expertise with Taleo Connect Client (TCC), including building and troubleshooting integrations independently.
* Demonstrated experience integrating Taleo with HRMS/ERP platforms (e.g., Oracle ERP/HCM), background check providers, job boards, and career sites.


***Technical \& Functional Skills***
* Strong functional command of the end\-to\-end recruitment process and how it maps to Taleo Recruiting, requisition lifecycle, candidate management, and offer processes.
* In\-depth, hands\-on knowledge of Taleo application features and functions across Recruiting, Onboarding, and Career Sections.
* Proficiency with XML, CSV, and data integration techniques, along with web services and APIs.
* Experience with Career Section configuration, branding, and localization.
* Strong reporting and analytics capability within the Taleo platform.


***Soft Skills***
* Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to present clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, negotiate, and drive alignment across cross\-functional and cross\-geography teams.
* Demonstrated vendor management experience, including managing SLAs, escalations, and deliverables with external partners.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making abilities.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and lead initiatives in a fast\-paced environment.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Oracle Taleo certification(s).
* Experience with Oracle HCM Cloud or Oracle ERP integrations.
* Exposure to global recruiting processes and compliance requirements (GDPR, EEOC, OFCCP).
* Prior experience in large enterprise or global HR/IT environments.


**Education**
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology , Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).


**What You Can Expect**

* An inclusive culture and community\-minded organization where giving back is encouraged

title: Global Candidate Engagement Lead Talent Services
description:
**Job title** 
 : Global Candidate Engagement Lead, Talent Services
   

  

* Location: Hyderabad


**About The Job**
 We are an innovative global healthcare company with one purpose: to chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. We’re also a company where you can flourish and grow your career, with countless opportunities to explore, make connections with people, and stretch the limits of what you thought was possible. Ready to get started?
   

  

 Join Sanofi in our Talent function and you can play a vital part in shaping the future of our workforce. Sanofi is on an exciting journey to revolutionize talent acquisition, and our global hubs are at the forefront of this transformation.
   

  

 This is an opportunity in our
 **Global Talent Services** 
 function at Sanofi Hubs. Sanofi ‘Hubs’ are where our key strategic business operations are hosted providing centralised services across Global Medical, Finance, People, Procurement, Digital, R\&D and more.
   

  

 Our Vision: We deliver best\-in\-class enterprise solutions and be the catalyst for modernization and transformation, enabling Sanofi to chase the miracles of science. Hubs are synonym to
 **GBS/GCC** 
 that is widely known in the industry.
   

  

**Global Talent Services** 
 is one of our key service lines in Hubs part of Chief Talent Office that helps provide E\-2\-E Talent Acquisition services globally to businesses spread across General Medicines, Specialty care, Vaccines, R\&D, Manufacturing from Hubs across regions in proximity. As
 **Global Candidate Engagement Lead, Talent Services** 
 , you will be accountable for delivering exceptional candidate experiences throughout the recruitment lifecycle. Leading and managing a team of Candidate Care Partners \& Candidate Care Specialists across all hubs, this role ensures consistent, positive, and high\-touch interactions with candidates at every stage. The Global Candidate Engagement Lead leverages data insights to drive performance improvements, collaborates closely with key stakeholders to optimize service delivery, and personally handles escalated candidate queries, demonstrating a commitment to candidate satisfaction.
   

  

 You will be responsible to assist in hiring the best talent for Sanofi and do this while providing world class candidate experience for sanofi globally. We are looking at volumes exceeding 20k. This is subjected to growth as we expand our launches in the region. You will be responsible to hire the best talent for Sanofi and do this while providing world class candidate experience. You will also be required to ensure service levels are met and hence will/may need to schedule as well
   

  

**Major Responsibilities**
* Lead, mentor, and manage the performance of the Candidate Care teams within the hubs, ensuring high levels of engagement, productivity, and service quality.
* Oversee the tracking and analysis of key performance metrics related to candidate care across all hubs.
* Partner closely with the Sourcing Hub Lead and Talent Acquisition Hub Lead to ensure seamless candidate experiences, consistent service delivery, and the attraction of top\-tier talent.
* Share best practices, identify areas for improvement, and drive alignment on candidate care processes and standards across all hubs.
* Partner with and upskill external vendors to ensure their candidate care practices align with Sanofi's global standards and processes, delivering a consistent "One Sanofi" experience.
* Act as a point of escalation for Candidate Care Partners, providing guidance, support, and timely resolution to challenging candidate issues.
* Coordinate candidate care service delivery across all hubs, ensuring coverage during required business hours and providing support in the required languages to meet the needs of a diverse candidate pool.
* Partner with the Executive Recruitment Lead in the hubs and COE to flexibly allocate resources and provide specialized candidate care support for executive\-level recruitment efforts as needed.


**About You**
 You are a highly motivated and experienced recruitment professional with a proven track record of success in leading and managing global recruitment teams, operating within a global business services environment and building new capability in talent teams. You are passionate about delivering exceptional experience and are driven by a desire to continuously improve recruitment processes and outcomes. You are a strategic thinker with a strong understanding of the talent acquisition landscape and are adept at building strong relationships with stakeholders at all levels
   

  

* Experience: Proven track record of success in running global teams
* Experience with the TA world – in any capacity. Awareness of the Hiring process
* Experience working with a Global CoE and driving standardization across multiple locations
* Six Sigma background and data analytics background
* Building new processes and structures \- with TA will be a plus
* Soft and technical skills: Cross\-Cultural Competence
* Leadership and Management Skills
* Stakeholder Management
* Candidate Experience Management
* Management Reporting
* Strategic Thinker
* Customer Experience
* Operational Delivery


**Languages** 
 : English
   

  

**Why choose us?**
* Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future\-focused team.
* Be a part of a dynamic and collaborative global team, influencing and shaping recruitment and sourcing strategies across the organization.
* Drive innovation and implement cutting\-edge recruitment and sourcing technologies/ methodologies to attract top talent in a competitive market.
* Make a real impact on Sanofi's mission by connecting the best talent with opportunities to improve people's lives.

title: HR Partner - Oakridge International School - Gachibowli
description:
Oakridge Gachibowli is a premium international day school in India. We have the proud privilege of being the pioneers of IB schooling in South India and one of the largest providers of IB education in India. We have 150\+ IB\-trained teachers with years of experience, helping us consistently achieve outstanding results and seeing our students go on to study at some of the world’s leading universities. Oakridge offers IB, CBSE, and Cambridge curricula, and is recognized as one of the best schools in Hyderabad, India.
   

  

 Oakridge International School, Gachibowli is a leading premium day school in India, with more than 2800 students in full time enrollment. The school has a proud legacy of 22 years educational excellence and of being the pioneers of IB schooling in South India and one of the largest providers of IB education in India. The school has 150\+ IB\-trained teachers, enabling consistent outstanding results and inspire students go on to study at some of the world’s leading universities. The school serves Nursery through to high school (Grade 12\) students. Oakridge offers IB, CBSE, and Cambridge curricula, and is recognized as one of the best schools in Hyderabad, India.
   

  

 The Oakridge International School, Gachibowli is partnered with the Nord Anglia Education family, the world’s leading premium international school organisation. They currently have 81 schools in India, China, Europe, the Middle East, South East Asia and North, Central and South America. NAE are a fast growing, successful education company with over 50 years’ experience. The schools are amongst the most respected premium schools in their markets and are a very popular choice for parents.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The HR Business Partner (HRBP) is a strategic role responsible for aligning HR practices with the school’s goals and educational mission. Acting as a trusted advisor to school leadership and faculty, the HRBP supports workforce planning, employee relations, talent management, performance development, and change management. The role ensures that HR initiatives promote a positive, inclusive, and high\-performing school culture.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic HR Partnership:** 
 Collaborate with school leadership to understand staffing needs and workforce planning.Align HR strategies with academic and operational goals.Provide data\-driven insights to support decision\-making and organizational effectiveness.
   

  

**Talent Acquisition \& Onboarding:** 
 Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements and lead recruitment for teaching, administrative, and support staff.Ensure timely onboarding and orientation of new hires.Promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in hiring practices.
   

  

**Employee Relations \& Engagement:** 
 Foster a positive work environment through proactive engagement and support.Handle employee concerns, grievances, and conflict resolution in a fair and consistent manner.Develop and implement initiatives that support staff well\-being and retention.
   

  

**Performance Management \& Development:** 
 Support performance appraisal processes and goal\-setting practices.Collaborate with department heads to identify professional development needs.Guide leadership and staff on career development opportunities and succession planning.
   

  

**Compliance \& Policy Implementation:** 
 Ensure compliance with labor laws, school policies, and relevant educational regulations.Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date HR documentation and records.Lead internal audits and HR reporting as needed.
   

  

 Detailed JD : JD \- HR Partner \- OIS.pdf
   

  

 At Nord Anglia Education we are committed to providing a world class, safe, happy environment in which children and young people can thrive and learn. We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all our pupils where we embrace all race, abilities, religions, genders, and cultures.
   

  

 All post holders in regulated activity (having regular unsupervised contact with children) are subject to appropriate national and international vetting procedures including satisfactory criminal record checks from both your country of residence/birth and any country of residence within the last 10 years.
   

  

 We welcome applications from suitable qualified persons from all diverse backgrounds.
   

  

 Please note, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: People & Culture Lead
description:
**People \& Culture Lead** 




**Hyderabad, India · Reports to Strategy ·** 
**India operations with US entity coordination** 




  





 Own the People function as a true Global HRBP for a 500\+ person India operation supporting a US\-headquartered entity. This is a strategic business\-partnering role first, and an operational ownership role second: you'll sit close to Founders and Function Leads as their HR counterpart across two geographies, shaping org design, talent strategy and workforce decisions in real time — while also owning the full employee lifecycle end to end.
 **Prior experience operating as an HRBP across multiple countries (ideally India \+ US) is required** 
 — this is not a single\-market generalist role.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




**Global HR Business Partnering (core of the role)** 




 Act as the primary HR partner to Founders and Function Leads across both the India and US contexts — understanding each business unit's goals and translating them into people strategy, org design, and workforce decisions. Advise on organisational design, role architecture, reporting structure and the levelling framework across two regulatory regimes and two talent markets. Bring a comparative lens: know how HR practices, employment norms and talent expectations differ between India and the US, and design policies/programmes that work coherently across both without defaulting to a single\-market template. Be the escalation point Founders and leaders turn to for judgment calls on people issues, not just process execution.
 



  





**Function ownership** 




 Own the P\&C agenda, roadmap and operating model globally. Own the organisational knowledge architecture \- SOPs, handbooks, lifecycle documentation and the knowledge directory \- and keep the documented record current and continuity\-proof across both entities.
 



  





**Talent acquisition** 




 Own hiring across technical and non\-technical roles in India, partnering with US\-side stakeholders on cross\-border hiring needs: requisition governance, pipeline health, interview frameworks and hiring manager enablement. Lead offer construction and closure for senior hires, with awareness of US compensation norms where relevant. Manage recruiting capacity including agency relationships.
 



  





**Compensation and equity** 




 Run the compensation cycle end to end \- benchmarking, band construction, moderation, approval and communication \- with fluency in both India and US market benchmarks. Administer the ESOP programme: grant recommendations, board cadence, documentation and employee communication.
 



  





**Benefits and people operations** 




 Design and roll out benefits including retirement schemes and insurance for the India population, while coordinating with US\-side HR/legal on benefits parity and obligations where applicable. Own payroll governance and vendor performance across employee and contractor populations, onboarding, leave and holiday framework, and HRIS data integrity and access governance.
 



  





**Performance and development** 




 Own the performance and goal\-setting cycle and its alignment to company objectives and board reporting, across both geographies. Design and facilitate manager and leadership development. Run recognition programmes tied to company values.
 



  





**Compliance and employee relations** 




 Hold accountability for statutory compliance across the India entity, including the Labour Codes and POSH, while coordinating closely with legal counsel and US HR/legal on US\-side employment obligations. Own worker classification policy and risk assessment across engagement models in both countries. Manage grievances and investigations, and operate separation processes for voluntary and business\-reason exits across both entities.
 



  





**Data and reporting** 




 Maintain headcount tracking, org charts and workforce data as the single source of truth across India and US populations. Prepare people data for board, investor and diligence requirements, and the analysis behind global headcount planning.
 



  





**Corporate transactions** 




 Support mergers, acquisitions and structural changes: people\-side due diligence, workforce mapping, retention planning, harmonisation of terms across jurisdictions, and post\-transaction integration. Prior M\&A experience is preferred.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* **Required:** 
 Demonstrated HRBP experience, with direct exposure to managing HR across at least two countries — India and US experience specifically preferred.
* Strong grasp of comparative employment law/practice basics between India and the US (this role owns statutory compliance in India and coordinates US obligations, not the reverse).
* Comfort operating as a strategic partner to founders/leadership, not just a process owner.
* Prior M\&A / corporate transaction exposure preferred.

title: Workforce Management Lead
description:
**Company Description**
 Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
   

  

**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
 Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
   

  

 As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
   

  

**For everyone, everywhere.**
**Job Description**
 More about
 **our mission** 
 and
 **what we offer** 
 .
   

  

 The WFM Team Lead – Scheduling \& Intraday leads the end\-to\-end tactical execution layer of Workforce Management, integrating schedule optimisation, weekly workforce steering, real\-time operational control, and incident response under a single, cohesive leadership structure.
   

  

 This role ensures that approved capacity strategies are translated into structurally sound, compliant schedules (0–30 day horizon), proactively adjusted through weekly tactical steering, and actively protected through disciplined intraday performance management.
   

  

 Beyond operational oversight, the role operates as the Workforce Command Center lead — providing governance, decision control, and service protection during both stable and volatile operating conditions. It ensures workforce decisions are data\-informed, risk\-quantified, and aligned to service, productivity, and cost objectives.
   

  

 As part of the WFM Centre of Excellence (CoE), the role is accountable for embedding standardised workforce governance, decision frameworks, incident protocols, and execution discipline across Scheduling and Intraday functions. It drives the transition from reactive workforce administration to structured, analytics\-driven workforce control at scale.
   

  

 This position closes the loop between Forecast → Capacity → Schedule → Intraday → Continuous Improvement, ensuring execution learnings systematically improve tactical and structural planning quality.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Team Leadership \& Capability Development
* Lead and develop Scheduling and Intraday WFM Specialists.
* Define clear accountability boundaries across tactical and real\-time scopes.
* Elevate analytical maturity beyond administrative execution.
* Coach team members in Scenario modelling, Workforce risk quantification, Structured incident response
* Build succession strength and capability depth.
* Foster a culture of data\-driven decision\-making and ownership.
* Tactical Planning \& Schedule Governance (0–30 Day Horizon)
* Own end\-to\-end schedule publication governance.
* Ensure schedules reflect approved capacity plans, are interval\-accurate and structurally optimised, comply with labour and contractual obligations
* Oversee scenario testing and trade\-off validation prior to release.
* Balance service protection with cost efficiency and schedule stability.
* Approve short\-term workforce interventions (OT, VTO, temporary uplift).
* Identify systemic schedule weaknesses before operational impact.
* Weekly Workforce Steering
* Lead weekly tactical workforce performance reviews.
* Identify structural and emerging risks across 1–3 week horizon.
* Drive proactive adjustments to reduce intraday volatility.
* Align closely with Forecasting and Capacity Planning on emerging shifts.
* Ensure continuous feedback loop from execution into planning assumptions.
* Intraday Performance \& Operational Control
* Oversee real\-time service level, occupancy, and productivity monitoring.
* Ensure structured and rapid deviation diagnosis.
* Guide stabilisation interventions to prevent performance oscillation.
* Maintain disciplined escalation protocols with Operations leadership.
* Safeguard service performance during peak volatility.
* Incident Management \& Command Center Leadership
* Act as the Workforce Command Center lead during operational disruption.
* Own structured workforce response to demand surges, high absenteeism events, system/tool outages, service\-level degradation
* Quantify operational risk exposure and recovery timelines.
* Coordinate cross\-functional workforce interventions.
* Ensure incidents are managed through defined protocols, not reactive decisions.
* Lead post\-incident reviews and embed systemic improvements.
* WFM CoE Governance \& Standardisation
* Enforce WFM execution standards across Scheduling and Intraday.
* Drive adoption of workforce governance frameworks, incident playbooks, tactical review cadences, decision documentation standards
* Reduce dependency on ad hoc, spreadsheet\-driven processes.
* Strengthen system\-based optimisation and automation.
* Ensure auditability, reproducibility, and structural integrity of workforce decisions.
* Contribute to maturity uplift of the WFM operating model.
* Continuous Improvement \& Execution Excellence
* Identify recurring volatility drivers.
* Improve shrinkage modelling and break optimisation logic.
* Increase automation and reporting maturity.
* Reduce emergency interventions and reactive staffing.
* Improve alignment between planning accuracy and operational execution.


**Qualifications**
 You are passionate about leading people, building teams, and making a difference in your work, while also having a strong understanding of operational teams and processes. You have experience working across global teams, across different functions and you understand how to communicate cross\-culturally. You get it done. You can identify and resolve issues independently, taking initiative even under unfamiliar or ambiguous circumstances. You’ve worked with BI tools before like Looker etc. and your Excel/Spreadsheets skills are advanced! SQL and Python skills are a plus.
   

  

* Experience as a people lead: At least 3 years of experience leading teams and 2 years in a Workforce Management role.
* Independent problem solver: Ability to identify and resolve issues independently, even in unfamiliar or ambiguous situations.
* Self\-starter: Proven track record of taking ownership and creatively solving problems, while improving efficiency.
* Strong understanding of WFM: Knowledgeable in forecasting and different forecasting models, capacity planning, scheduling, and real\-time management.
* Strong relationships with stakeholders: Ability to connect and maintain relationships with various internal teams.
* Strategic and data\-driven: Ability to think strategically, translate strategy into operational plans, and analyse and interpret data.
* Process Expert: Lean Six Sigma experience to green\-belt level, understanding how to formally document processes, automate, improve efficiency, and reduce waste and cycle times across WFM practices


 Additional Information
   

  

 For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
   

  

 We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
   

  

 Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
   

  

 If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.
   

  

 Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

title: Assistant Manager - HR Operations-Reward

Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
   

  

 Human Resources
   

  

 Our HR Team are the force for good that bring Reckitt's ambition to life. We work together to ensure the delivery of sustained profitable growth by unleashing the power of our purpose, people and performance. Now is an exciting time to be part of shaping the future of HR, influencing an exciting global organisation, while developing business and functional leadership skills, all at the same time. Whatever your role in our HR community, you'll take ownership of your projects and workstreams. We focus on developing our leaders to spearhead our culture and growth, so you'll be supported and mentored to deliver the right plans to drive business performance \- and we'll celebrate the results with you along the way.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Assistant Manager – Reward Operations plays a critical role within GPS Reward, acting as a Reward subject matter expert and operational leader for core Reward processes. While the role has a strong operational backbone, it also requires solid Reward knowledge, professional judgement, and the confidence to challenge and improve how work is done.
   

  

 This role is responsible not only for delivering Reward operations with high quality and discipline, but also for acting as a focal point for HR and business stakeholders, translating Reward principles into practical execution, identifying risks, and driving continuous improvement across processes, controls, and user experience.
   

  

 The role combines operational leadership (\~60–65%) with Reward expertise, advisory capability, and improvement leadership (\~35–40%).
   

  

 Your responsibilities
   

  

* Lead end to end delivery of core Reward processes, including Annual Pay Review, Bonus/APP payouts, and off cycle compensation changes, with full accountability for quality and accuracy.
* Act as a trusted operational partner to HRBPs, Reward COE, Payroll, Finance, and the business, providing clear guidance and challenge where needed.
* Own ticket management and escalations, ensuring SLA adherence while reducing repeat issues through root cause analysis.
* Maintain and continuously improve SOPs, controls, and documentation to support scalability and cross coverage.
* Identify process gaps, risks, and inefficiencies; propose and drive improvements, including automation and system enhancements.
* Provide operational insights to the Reward COE to influence future Reward design and governance.


 The experience we're looking for
   

  

* Solid Reward knowledge (performance pay, salary structures, compensation letters).
* Experience managing complex Reward operations with sound judgement and attention to detail.
* Confidence to challenge stakeholders constructively and uphold Reward principles.
* Strong analytical skills and advanced Excel proficiency.
* Experience with HR systems and ticketing tools (e.g. Workday, SAP, ServiceNow, beqom).
* Clear communication skills and a continuous improvement mindset.


 The skills for success
   

  

 Diversity and inclusion, Data and Analytics, Storytelling; Data led storytelling, Organisational structure, Coaching skills; Facilitation skills, Change management, Execute plans, Strategic mindset, Employment engagement, Digital literacy, Commercial accumen, Courageous leadership.
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

 With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short\-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
   

  

 Equality
   

  

 We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

title: VP - Business Manager
description:
**Job Title: VP\- Business Manager**
 HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected, and opinions count. We foster continuous professional development, flexible working, and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. As part of the Risk \& Compliance (R\&C) function, you’ll play a vital role in supporting HSBC’s second line of defence, ensuring robust risk management and operational excellence across the Group.
   

  

 The Risk \& Compliance (R\&C) function is HSBC’s Second Line of Defence, responsible for reviewing and challenging the activities of the Group’s businesses to ensure effective risk management. With a global headcount of \~14,000 and annual costs of \~$1\.5bn, R\&C is evolving its operating model, requiring robust oversight, administration, and management. This role is pivotal in supporting the R\&C CAO CoE, driving operational excellence, and enabling strategic objectives in a dynamic, highly scrutinized environment. The role holder needs to understand the impact of all these changes on Risk \& Compliance and HSBC and support the Global R\&C COO, Global R\&C CAO and Head CAO CoE as necessary. The role holder will be required to interact with many internal and external parties at the highest level of management and therefore needs an outstanding level of professionalism and gravitas. As a Senior Business Manager within the R\&C C oE, you will be a strategic partner to Lines of Business and Global R\&C Sub\-functions, helping leaders turn centrally produced financial, workforce and performance data into clear decisions and practical action. You will connect insight with business context, identify risks and opportunities, generate ideas to improve performance and help shape priorities across the function. Reporting to the R\&C Head of CAO CoE India, you will work with global, regional and business stakeholders to translate information into a compelling performance story, challenge assumptions and coordinate delivery. Financial analysis and tracking remain important; however, the core data and reporting are produced centrally. Your value will come from interpreting what the data means, asking the right questions and enabling timely, well\-informed choices.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will combine strong business judgement, curiosity and influencing skills with an understanding of risk management and organisational performance. They will be comfortable leading a team, navigating a global matrix and moving stakeholders from insight to action.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
 The role holder will share good practice globally, lead a team and build trusted relationships across the function. Key responsibilities include:
   

  

* Partner with the Global R\&C CAO wider team and senior leaders to understand priorities, performance and delivery challenges across assigned Lines of Business and Global Sub\-functions. Use centrally produced financial, workforce and performance information to build a clear view of what is changing, why it matters and where leadership action is required.
* Identify trends, risks, opportunities and emerging themes, connecting information across teams to generate ideas for improved performance, effectiveness and service delivery. Challenge assumptions and test whether plans, resources and investments remain aligned to business priorities.
* Use scenario analysis to explore choices, trade\-offs and potential outcomes for the relevant Sub\-function or Line of Business.
* Support decisions on consultancy, third\-party spend, hiring and out\-of\-plan requirements by assessing business need, value and alignment to priorities. Track agreed actions and outcomes, helping leaders understand whether interventions are delivering the intended impact.
* Support senior leaders across Lines of Business and Sub\-functions with integrated business management covering performance, people, priorities, governance and organisational effectiveness. Create clear leadership narratives from centrally produced Management Information, focusing discussion on decisions, actions and opportunities rather than reporting alone.
* Coordinate business planning and governance rhythms, ensuring priorities, dependencies and actions remain visible and connected. Coordinate and execute the business change and organisational design activity required to deliver the agreed financial resource plan, across both cost and FTE
* Build trusted relationships with R\&C leadership and partners across the Global Businesses, Global Functions, Finance and HR. Facilitate constructive, evidence\-based conversations that help stakeholders align on priorities and make timely decisions.
* Bring together perspectives from global and regional stakeholders to spot themes, share learning and scale effective ideas. Provide constructive challenge to existing practices and proposed initiatives, developing practical solutions to complex issues.
* Identify opportunities to improve value, simplify activity and redirect resources to the areas of greatest strategic importance.
* Lead, coach and develop direct reports, creating clear priorities and promoting curiosity, collaboration and high\-quality delivery. Support effective performance, talent and succession management across the team


**To Be Successful You Will**
**Knowledge \& Qualifications**
* Strong understanding of business management, organisational performance and strategy execution.
* Ability to interpret financial, workforce and operational information and connect it to business context and decisions. Sound understanding of the external banking environment, including regulatory, political and competitive factors.
* Strong awareness of internal control, operational risk and the role of Risk \& Compliance.
* Awareness of data governance and the importance of reliable, consistent information for decision\-making. Demonstrated success in using business, financial, workforce or operational insight to influence senior decisions and improve outcomes. Experience turning complex data and competing viewpoints into clear narratives, options and recommendations.
* Proven ability to identify opportunities, generate practical ideas and lead performance or organisational improvement.
* Experience working with central Finance, HR or data teams and applying their outputs within a business context.
* Strong stakeholder management experience in a complex, global matrix organisation. Experience shaping and delivering people, capability or engagement plans across diverse teams.
* Experience coordinating and executing business change and organisational design activity to deliver cost and FTE plans. Strategic and commercial judgement, with the ability to connect insight to business priorities. Intellectual curiosity and confidence asking questions that uncover the story behind the data.
* Ability to spot patterns, risks and opportunities and develop practical ideas in response.
* Excellent communication, storytelling and influencing skills, including with senior stakeholders. Strong leadership, collaboration and facilitation skills.
* Comfort interpreting data and scenarios without needing to own the underlying financial production processes.
* Proactive, resilient and effective in a fast\-moving international environment. Outstanding organisational and problem management skills, and extensive project and programme management exposure

 You’ll achieve more at HSBC**

title: FBS Workforce Insights Consultant
description:
Supports HR Reporting and Analytics to solve business problems using quantitative and qualitative analysis for resolution. Analyzes workforce metrics, trends/patterns and statistical models to solve information problems. Assists in developing related predictive analytics. Supports standard reporting and data analysis needs and/or local support of information systems in HR. Assists support team members with understanding data and meeting user requirements. Participates in project work groups with Subject Matter Experts and stakeholders to support data specific needs.
   

  

**Essential Job Functions**
 Assists in the creation and maintenance of standard management and ad hoc reports. Provide quantitative comparisons of data points using statistical analysis communicated in a manner understandable to business stakeholders. Gather requirements based on customer needs. Collaborate with subject matter experts across the HR service areas (COEs and HRBP/HR Consultant team) and finance to promote data governance and stewardship and to improve overall strategic and operational performance and insight. Communicate findings in a clear and simple manner with excellent written and oral communication skills. Complies with all rules and laws and HR policies and procedures related to information systems. Ensures confidentiality of records and HR information. Execute reporting and analysis with a focus on process improvement. Supports running models and reports to analyze workforce data to identify significant differences, relationships, root causes and trends. Report results of statistical analyses in the form of graphs, charts, and tables. Analyze reports to support the organization. Extract data from a variety of sources (databases, web, text files) and in a variety of formats (structured, unstructured). Construct and validate predictive models using a variety of techniques. Manage multiple basic to intermediate level projects that support HR and business needs. Keep all projects highly organized. Project Management. Provides training solutions to end users and further develops Manager and HR self\-service in the reporting function to meet client needs. Continuously research and learn new data science tools and techniques to find applicability at Farmers.
   

  

**Requirements**
 Minimum three years analytics experience in relevant field Experience in proactively identifying, prioritizing and delivering small to mid size projects which have demonstrable benefits for the business. Remains current with governmental regulations which affect HR information systems and participates and helps develop changes and enh ancements with the global GEMS team. Basic process design and mapping skills. General knowledge of measurement and statistics. Strong interpersonal, communication, time management skills (deleted influencing skills). title: Senior Associate - Resource Management
description:
**Position Summary**
 The Senior Associate, Resource Management supports staffing, scheduling, capacity planning, workforce analytics, and resource optimization activities for the India Tax practice. This role works closely with the Manager, Talent Optimization and Tax leadership to facilitate effective resource deployment, monitor capacity and utilization, support staffing decisions, and maintain accurate workforce data.
   

  

 The Senior Associate serves as a key contributor to workforce planning efforts by providing reporting, analysis, and operational support to help ensure resources are aligned with business demands while supporting employee development, engagement objectives, and operational excellence across U.S. and India teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Scheduling \& Staffing Support**
* Support the scheduling of tax professionals across multiple industries within the India Tax team.
* Assist with processing staffing requests and ensuring schedules remain accurate, current, and aligned with business needs.
* Monitor resource availability, capacity, PTO, training, and other scheduling commitments.
* Identify potential scheduling conflicts, capacity constraints, or workload imbalances and communicate findings to the Manager, Talent Optimization.
* Assist with work transitions, reassignments, and workload balancing activities as directed.
* Maintain accurate staffing information in scheduling tools, trackers, reports, and workforce planning systems.


**Capacity, Utilization \& Workforce Analytics**
* Prepare and analyze capacity, utilization, staffing, and availability reports for leadership review.
* Track employee availability, chargeable hour projections, and scheduled commitments to support workforce visibility.
* Monitor schedule changes and ensure updates are reflected in timely reporting systems.
* Identify trends in staffing, utilization, and resource availability and communicate insights to support decision\-making.
* Support data validation efforts to improve reporting accuracy, workforce visibility, and data integrity.
* Assist in workforce planning activities by monitoring forecasted workload, resource demand, and skill requirements.
* Provide scheduling, utilization, and capacity\-related information as requested by management.


**Coordination \& Stakeholder Communication**
* Serve as a resource for routine scheduling inquiries from team members, managers, and engagement teams.
* Coordinate with U.S. and India Tax teams to gather staffing information, scheduling updates, and resource needs.
* Build effective working relationships with U.S. and India leadership teams to support resource deployment decisions.
* Facilitate communication regarding staffing conflicts, priorities, workload balancing, and schedule changes.
* Escalate staffing concerns, scheduling issues, or capacity risks to the Manager, Talent Optimization when appropriate.


**Process \& Administrative Support**
* Follow established scheduling procedures, guidelines, and best practices.
* Assist with maintaining scheduling documentation, process materials, and training resources.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance scheduling efficiency, reporting quality, and data accuracy.
* Participate in team meetings, scheduling calls, capacity review exercises, and workforce planning discussions.
* Assist with onboarding and training activities related to scheduling tools, reporting processes, and resource management procedures.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in business, Accounting, Finance, Human Resources, Operations, or related fields.
* 2\-4 years of experience in resource management, workforce planning, scheduling, professional services operations, project coordination, or related discipline.
* Experience in a CPA firm, tax practice, public accounting, or professional services environment preferred.
* Strong Excel and reporting skills, including pivot tables, data analysis, and report preparation.
* Experience with resource management, workforce planning, scheduling, ERP, or reporting platforms; Microsoft Dynamics or similar systems preferred.
* Excellent attention to detail, organization, critical thinking, and follow\-through.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to coordinate across teams and levels.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and shift business needs in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify issues, summarize findings, and support practical solutions.

 Resource Coordination
   

  

 Relationship Management
   

  

 Schedule Management
   

  

 Problem Solving
   

  

 Capacity Planning \& Tracking
   

  

 Business Acumen
   

  

 Workforce Analytics
   

  

 Time Management
   

  

 Operational Support
   

  

 Attention to Detail
   

  

 Data Accuracy \& Reporting
   

  

 Adaptability
   

  

**Success Measures**
* Accuracy and integrity of staffing, scheduling, and workforce planning data.

* Quality, reliability, and usefulness of capacity, utilization, and availability reporting.
* Proactive identification and communication of capacity constraints, staffing risks, and workload imbalances.

title: Contingent Workforce Analyst II
description:
**Role Overview**
 The Contingent Workforce Approvals Analyst administers the approval workflow for temporary staff requests. The role monitors the intake form daily, checks each submission for completeness and accuracy, chases the requester for whatever is missing, puts the record into the format the approvers need, routes it to the right director and vendor manager, and tracks it through to final sign\-off and notification.
   

  

 This is a pivotal governance role, balancing administrative diligence with rigorous policy enforcement. Each verification step is essential: validating hiring manager hierarchies ensures proper authorization, location codes dictate cost and compliance protocols, budget confirmations prevent unapproved spending, and length\-of\-service tracking maintains policy adherence. Serving as the primary control point, you will mitigate risk by ensuring all requests are accurate and complete before processing, proactively preventing potential downstream compliance or operational exposure.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Request Intake \& Completeness Review
* Monitor submissions from the internal approval form daily, so no request waits on the analyst to notice it.
* Review each submission for completeness and accuracy, including hiring manager hierarchy, location codes and budget confirmation.
* Verify the requester has the standing to raise the request and that the approving hierarchy is correctly identified.
* Hold back incomplete or non\-compliant requests rather than routing them onward, and record why.
* Log every request so volume, ageing and approval cycle time can be reported.
* Clarification \& Data Finalisation
* Follow up with requesters using the established templates to resolve missing information, incorrect data formats and insufficient justification.
* Update request records into the required format, ensuring the scope of work detail and the objectives the role supports are captured.
* For extensions, include the previous request identifiers and length\-of\-service detail, since these determine whether the extension is permissible.
* Confirm budget and cost\-centre detail is present and consistent before the request moves to approval.
* Keep the requester informed, since these requests usually have a start date depending on them.
* Approval Routing \& Tracking
* Assign the appropriate director and vendor manager to each request based on the confirmed hierarchy.
* Loop in the assigned vendor manager for review and track the request through to final sign\-off.
* Chase approvals that stall, and escalate where a delay puts a start date or a compliance position at risk.
* Maintain accurate approval status throughout, so anyone can see where a request stands without asking.
* Handle rejections and rework cleanly, returning the request with a clear reason.
* Notification, Documentation \& Reporting
* Send approval notifications to hiring managers and requesters once a decision is reached.
* Record the final decision date and maintain the complete record of the approval chain.
* Provide the documentation required for extensions to the requester.
* Report on request volumes, approval cycle times, rejection reasons and ageing.
* Maintain the templates, procedures and knowledge base for the workflow, and propose improvements where the same clarification is needed repeatedly.


 PERFORMANCE \& SERVICE LEVELS
   

  

 Indicative performance targets for the role; final service levels are confirmed on engagement and measured per service line.
   

  

* Daily Monitoring: intake reviewed every business day, with no submission left unactioned overnight.
* Completeness Check: 100% of requests validated against the mandatory field set before routing; zero incomplete requests routed to approvers.
* Clarification Turnaround: requester follow\-up issued within the agreed window of identifying a gap.
* Approval Tracking: 100% of in\-flight requests carrying an accurate current status, with stalled approvals chased.
* Notification: decisions communicated and decision dates recorded for 100% of closed requests.
* Policy Compliance: extensions processed only with previous request identifiers and length\-of\-service detail present.
* First Meaningful Response: provide a meaningful technical update on 90% of requests within 2 business hours.
* Ticket Quality: sustain ≥95% against the weighted quality scorecard, which is weighted toward technical accuracy, then completeness, timeliness and communication.
* Customer Satisfaction: sustain ≥95% of responses rated Excellent or Good.


 TOOLS \& SYSTEMS
   

  

* Intake and workflow: the internal approval form and request tracker for submissions and status.
* Communication: shared mailbox, email templates and enterprise chat for requester and approver follow\-up.
* Records and reporting: spreadsheet trackers and BI tooling for cycle time, ageing and rejection analysis.
* Directory and organisational data: hierarchy and cost\-centre reference data used to identify the correct approvers.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
 Mandatory
   

  

* 2–5\+ years in workflow administration, contingent workforce or vendor management support, HR operations, or a comparable approvals and compliance coordination role.
* Demonstrated discipline validating submissions against a mandatory field set and holding back non\-compliant requests.
* Comfort navigating organisational hierarchies and identifying the correct approving authority.
* Accurate handling of cost\-centre, budget and location reference data.
* Excellent written English, since the role runs largely on templated follow\-up with senior stakeholders.
* Confidentiality judgement, as requests contain personal and commercial information.
* Willing and able to work a shift\-based roster, including night shifts, from the Hyderabad delivery centre.


**Preferred**
* Contingent workforce or vendor management systems experience.
* Exposure to length\-of\-service, tenure or co\-employment policy controls.
* Workflow or approvals automation experience.
* Reporting and dashboard building on cycle time and approval throughput.
* Procurement or HR operations certification, or working towards one.

**Description**
 At Amazon, HR Partners (HRP) provide high\-judgment HR support to managers across levels at scale, enabling them to become force multipliers for customer impact and positive employee experience. They demonstrate advanced knowledge of HR policies, processes, and tools, acting as trusted consultants to managers and senior managers. HRPs work backwards from the voice of the manager to deliver personalized experiences and drive large\-scale initiatives using technology and simplified processes that match the speed and agility of our business. They operate independently as subject matter experts with deep knowledge of regional programs and policies, collaborating extensively with PXT teams including HR Business Partners, Employee Relations, Legal, and others to provide integrated people solutions. As established practitioners, they mentor junior team members and shape best practices across the region.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Managers and senior managers collaborate with Senior HR Partners to support sensitive and often complex employee issues including disciplinary, performance improvement and grievance processes. The Sr. HRP acts as an influential partner in helping managers with talent and performance management processes, people development, HR policies and implementation of organizational changes at the country or regional level. Thanks to their front\-line visibility across businesses, Sr. HRPs are in a position to spot trends, identify emerging needs and address them in collaboration with the appropriate business and HR stakeholders. Sr. HRPs are also expected to partner on complex global and regional strategic priorities and process improvement initiatives. As a subject matter expert, Sr. HRPs mentor and guide junior team members.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities Include**
* Performance Management: Partner with managers on complex and nuanced performance management cases including performance improvement plans and assessments. Guide managers in implementing performance management processes and tools effectively. Partner with managers to ensure bias\-free evaluations and effective coaching approaches across teams. Analyze performance data to identify trends, share insights, and develop solutions for systemic issues.
* Employee Relations: Handle complex and nuanced employee relations cases and investigations following established processes and policies. Conduct thorough and impartial investigations, support grievance processes, and lead informal discussions or mediation. Provide guidance to managers on sophisticated ER matters including policy violations and workplace concerns across countries. Partner with Legal and Employee Relations teams to resolve sensitive cases while ensuring compliance and risk mitigation. Analyze investigation findings, prepare recommendations, and identify trends to prevent future risks.
* HR General: Act as stewards of the employee experience and Amazon’s culture. Act as subject matter expert for people tools, processes, programs or projects. Design and deliver Manager Education initiatives to further drive collective education and manager effectiveness. Analyze data and observations across the organization, highlighting trends and recommending/driving solutions, as appropriate.
* Change Management: Drive implementation of employee programs and lead improvements in manager experience. Partner with HR Business Partners and central teams on complex change initiatives across countries. Use data and insights to advocate for and influence process improvements. Design and execute change management strategies to ensure effective adoption across diverse employee groups.
* Process Improvement: Drive complex strategic priorities and process improvement initiatives across India. Partner with global HRP team, other HR teams and CoEs to drive global and regional HRP strategic projects.


 This role is performed through an innovative customer relationship Management tool that enables this team to be uniquely positioned to identify trending issues and themes through data and inform consequent decisions and initiatives.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in business, HR, or a related field, or 5\+ years of human resources experience and Bachelor's degree
* Experience delivering results by partnering with and influencing others
* Experience coaching and mentoring at the management level
* Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment
* Experience in computer skills, including proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
* Experience working effectively across cross\-functional teams and partnering well with people at all levels within an organization
* Business and HR acumen, including problem solving skills, critical thinking, and self\-initiative


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree in Human Resources or related field with about 6\-10 years’ work experience. Proven track record of accomplishments in a dynamic environment, which is fast paced and customer driven. Proven ability to prioritize, meet deadlines and make the best use of available resources. Project management and the ability to deliver, with a proven track record of influencing through data\-driven recommendations. Coaching and consulting skills; Ability to work with and influence multiple stakeholders. Experience in dealing with contingent workforce will be an advantage. Presentation skills and knowledge of employment laws.


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. description:
Your opportunity
   

  

**Schwab Description**
 At Charles Schwab, our purpose is simple: we champion client’s goals with passion and integrity. Guided by honesty, mutual respect and a commitment to doing what’s right, we bring innovation, education, and service together to help shape financial futures. Our people are the foundation of our success – they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities. As we expand into India, we are bringing this same culture of inclusion, learning, and opportunity to new talent. Joining us means becoming part of a global team where your work matters and your future can take shape.
   

  

**Schwab India Description**
 Our Hyderabad location is central to Schwab’s growth, bringing together talented people and technology to drive innovation, scale and efficiency. Here, you will work alongside teams who create solutions that support millions of clients every day. The work you do is more than daily operations – it’s a chance to experiment, learn, and build within a values\-driven, supportive environment. This is a unique opportunity to be part of our early growth phase and shape something new, backed by the stability and strength of a Fortune 500 company. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region.
   

  

 What you have
   

  

 Role Description
   

  

 The Strategy \& Change Manager is a senior individual contributor responsible for translating enterprise priorities into executable strategies, coordinated transformation plans, and sustainable change outcomes. The role partners with business and functional leaders to support strategic planning, capability growth, operating model evolution, and organizational readiness.
   

  

 The incumbent will develop business cases, strategic roadmaps, change strategies, readiness assessments, governance mechanisms, and value tracking approaches. Working across business, technology, operations, risk, finance, legal, HR, and enterprise teams, the role will help implement priority initiatives with strong execution discipline, stakeholder alignment, risk awareness, and measurable outcomes.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Strategy Development \& Execution
   

  

* Partner with CSIN SLT and other enterprise stakeholders to support strategic planning, capability growth, and transformation priorities.
* Develop strategic roadmaps that connect business priorities, workforce considerations, transition objectives, and operational outcomes.
* Conduct research, benchmarking, and analysis to identify opportunities for growth, efficiency, and organizational effectiveness.
* Develop business cases, investment proposals, executive presentations, and recommendations for priority initiatives.
* Track strategic initiatives, surface risks and dependencies, and provide decision\-ready insights to leadership.


 Transformation \& Operating Model Enablement
   

  

* Support design and implementation of scalable operating models, governance structures, and execution frameworks.
* Manage or coordinate cross\-functional transformation workstreams, milestones, dependencies, and action closure.
* Drive initiatives focused on process optimization, standardization, organizational effectiveness, and operational efficiency.
* Develop practical playbooks, methodologies, and repeatable tools that improve consistency across initiatives.
* Assess organizational impacts and recommend process, governance, role, or ways\-of\-working changes required for sustainable scale.


 Change Management \& Organizational Readiness
   

  

* Develop and execute change strategies for new operating models, capability transitions, and transformation initiatives.
* Conduct stakeholder assessments, change impact analyses, readiness evaluations, and adoption planning.
* Develop stakeholder engagement, communication, listening, training, and reinforcement plans in partnership with relevant teams.
* Identify resistance, readiness gaps, and adoption risks, and implement practical mitigation actions.
* Partner with leaders and change champions to embed new processes, governance structures, behaviors, and ways of working.
* Monitor adoption and readiness indicators, gather feedback, and adjust interventions to sustain change.


 Transition \& Migration Support
   

  

* Support transition programs from opportunity assessment and planning through migration, stabilization, and value realization.
* Develop transition plans, readiness assessments, implementation roadmaps, governance routines, and success measures.
* Coordinate knowledge transfer, documentation, operational readiness, handoffs, and stabilization activities.
* Maintain visibility of milestones, interdependencies, risks, decisions, and mitigation actions.
* Help ensure business continuity, stakeholder confidence, and achievement of agreed operational outcomes during transition.


 Stakeholder Engagement \& Executive Communication
   

  

* Build trusted partnerships across global and local stakeholders in a highly matrixed environment.
* Develop clear change narratives, leadership messages, executive updates, town hall materials, FAQs, and communication toolkits.
* Facilitate workshops, working sessions, governance reviews, and decision discussions.
* Synthesize complex information into concise choices, recommendations, and leadership\-ready materials.
* Influence without direct authority and create alignment across diverse stakeholder groups.


 Risk Management, Governance \& Value Realization
   

  

* Identify transformation, transition, operational, regulatory, and organizational risks throughout the initiative lifecycle.
* Maintain governance routines, decision logs, progress reporting, escalation paths, and mitigation tracking.
* Define KPIs, adoption indicators, and value measures aligned with business case commitments.
* Track benefits realization, operational outcomes, and lessons learned, and recommend corrective actions.
* Support continuous improvement, business continuity, resilience, and long\-term operational maturity.


**Required Qualifications**
* Masters degree in Business, Strategy, Organizational Development or a related field.
* 8\+ years of experience in strategy, organizational change management, transformation, consulting, program management, business operations, transition management, or related disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience supporting complex transformation, change, operating model, or business enablement initiatives.
* Experience developing business cases, strategic roadmaps, change strategies, readiness assessments, and executive\-level materials.
* Strong understanding of change management, program governance, stakeholder engagement, and benefits realization practices.
* Proven ability to influence stakeholders and drive outcomes across highly matrixed environments.
* Excellent analytical, facilitation, executive communication, stakeholder management, and execution skills.
* Ability to manage ambiguity, multiple priorities, and cross\-functional dependencies with high ownership.


 What’s in it for you
   

  

 At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration – so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long\-term financial security.
   

  

**Our Base Benefits, Wellbeing, And Total Rewards Include**
* Competitive compensation and retirement programs including Employee Provident Fund (EPF), Gratuity, and optional National Pension System (NPS) contributions
* Robust Paid Time Off, including annual/privilege leave, sick and casual leave, public holidays, maternity/paternity leave, and more
* Education assistance for continued learning to help you grow
* Comprehensive medical insurance with Outpatient Department (OPD) services, including vaccination, pharmacy, dental, and vision coverage
* Annual reimbursement for health check\-ups and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Childcare (creche) reimbursement for eligible employees
* Transportation and meal benefits that support your day\-to\-day work
* Group life, personal accident, and critical illness insurance

 iMerit – An EXL Company is looking for a highly energetic HR team member who will lead and manage the Engagement portfolio and the connected team. The Employee Engagement Manager will play a key role in the development and implementation of engagement strategies, best practice guidelines, as well as supporting critical change programs. Work on Employer Branding\- participation in HR awards, and HR marketing aspects with the organization marketing team. You will create and communications and engagement guidance to senior internal stakeholders, oversee our business as usual internal communications and engagement \- ranging from our intranet and regular e\-newsletter to employee surveys, reward schemes and events \- and take a central role in several other employee engagement initiatives.
 



  





 The successful applicant will need to work closely with stakeholders across the organization, most notably HR team and leadership as well as other audience that is responsible for employee engagement.
 



  





**Job description**




  





 • Deliver end\-to\-end internal employee engagement plans and campaigns to inspire and engage employees. This will involve supporting senior leaders in their communications efforts in keeping their functions informed of updates and changes in consistent and engaging ways.
 



  





 • Lead on the development and delivery of a global engagement and communications calendar ensuring all initiatives/activities are delivered and communicated about in timely and efficient ways. Execute HR Engagement plans and lead the HR engagement team to meet all requirements and deadlines. Roll up your sleeves as an individual contributor wherever needed.
 



  





 • Communications Strategy \& Implementation\- Develop, execute, and evaluate an internal communications strategy, ensuring that business goals, initiatives and organizational/people news are communicated regularly and effectively.

 • Employee Engagement surveys \- Our employee surveys help form key employee engagement activities to continue with, refine or implement going forward.
 



  





 o Co\-lead on the design, and management of the bi\-annual roll\-out Employee Engagement Surveys.
 



 o Provide input on the design of the employee surveys and support the internal communications efforts in communicating the results to key stakeholders in a timely fashion.
 



 o Provide input and evaluation on global and regional level outcomes and create deep dives for actionization.
 



  





 • Build and foster relationships across business functions and locations to ensure employees are engaged and informed no matter where they are based. Enable employees to have an opportunity for dialogue.
 



  





 • Gather, analyze and present key employee engagement metrics to help support the delivery of key initiatives and prepare reports for key stakeholders in a timely fashion.
 



  





 • Rewards and Recognitions\- Create implement and run a R\&R structure for the organization which foster high energy and performance culture.

**Education : Specialized education in HR/Psychology**

 Experience in high growth/startup culture is added advantage.
